preconditions: Disposable VM/block image with recorded filesystem, mount, SQLite, kernel, systemd, RTC, and NTP configuration
External hard-power or block-I/O fault control
Clock control cannot affect another workload
Cycles are posture-only or use a non-effecting AG fixture
power_loss_cuts: after slot claim before support query
after support response before posture transaction
after exact AG request preparation before AG response
after AG response before Nightshift reference persistence
after settlement observation before observation-required persistence
clock_faults: wall clock steps backward before nominal due instant
wall clock steps backward during an active slot
wall clock steps backward after a completed slot
RTC/boot time precedes the prior persisted observation
NTP correction crosses recurrence or horizon equality
procedure: Run preflight.py --profile fault-injection and snapshot the pristine image
Inject exactly one declared storage or clock fault per restored image
For storage cuts, capture the image before recovery and clone it
Run SQLite integrity checks and exact cycle replay after recovery
Verify one authoritative slot, explicit open-cycle classification, no live-lease/currentness reconstruction, and no duplicate AG request
For clock faults, capture realtime and monotonic coordinates, systemd timer properties, and Nightshift refusal/attention behavior
Verify old support, diagnostic posture, headline, generation, and slot records do not regain current force
Seal images or image hashes, fault traces, journals, databases, and replay outputs
forbidden_shortcuts: ordinary restart represented as wall-clock rollback
fixture currentness represented as Pulse operational evidence
